1.title: 5.1 Leadership and Commitment
1.description: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment to the effectiveness and continual improvement of the EnMS. This includes ensuring the integration of the EnMS into the organization's business processes, establishing the energy policy and objectives, and ensuring the availability of necessary resources.

2.title: 5.2 Energy Policy
2.description: Top management must establish, implement, and maintain an energy policy that is appropriate to the purpose of the organization, provides a framework for setting objectives, and includes a commitment to continual improvement.

3.title: 5.3 Organizational Roles, Responsibilities and Authorities
3.description: Top management must ensure that responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned and communicated within the organization. Specific responsibilities should be assigned to the energy management team.

1.title: 6.1 Actions to Address Risks and Opportunities
1.description: When planning for the EnMS, the organization shall consider and address the relevant risks and opportunities to assure intended outcomes, prevent undesired effects, and achieve continual improvement.

2.title: 6.2 Objectives, Energy Targets and Planning
2.description: The organization shall establish and maintain measurable energy objectives at relevant functions and levels, and create action plans to achieve them.

3.title: 6.3 Energy Review
3.description: The organization shall develop and implement an energy review process to analyze energy use and consumption, identifying significant energy uses (SEUs) and opportunities for improving energy performance.

template.description: Determination of which devices consume the most (Pareto analysis).

4.title: 6.4 Energy Performance Indicators (EnPIs)
4.description: The organization shall identify and use appropriate energy performance indicators (EnPIs) to demonstrate improvements in energy performance.

template.description: Determination of baseline year and performance formula.

5.title: 6.5 Energy Baseline (EnB)
5.description: The organization shall establish one or more energy baselines (EnBs) based on data from a suitable time period to compare energy performance.

template.description: Determination of baseline year and performance formula.

6.title: 6.6 Planning for Collection of Energy Data
6.description: The organization shall define and implement a data collection plan to collect the necessary data for monitoring SEUs and other key elements affecting energy performance.

1.title: 7.1 Resources
1.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the EnMS.

2.title: 7.2 Competence
2.description: The organization shall ensure that personnel affecting energy performance are competent on the basis of appropriate education, training, skills, or experience.

3.title: 7.3 Awareness
3.description: Persons under the organization's control shall be aware of the energy policy, their contribution to the EnMS, and the implications of not conforming with its requirements.

4.title: 7.4 Communication
4.description: The organization shall determine the internal and external communications relevant to the EnMS, including what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates.

5.title: 7.5 Documented Information
5.description: The organization's EnMS shall include, create, and control documented information required by this standard and deemed necessary by the organization for the effectiveness of the EnMS.

template.description: Procedure describing how to perform analyses (SOP).

1.title: 8.1 Operational Planning and Control
1.description: The organization shall plan, implement, and control the processes related to significant energy uses (SEUs) according to established criteria. Changes must be planned, and their consequences reviewed.

2.title: 8.2 Design
2.description: The organization shall consider performance improvement opportunities and operational controls in the design of new, modified, and renovated facilities, equipment, systems, and processes that can have a significant impact on energy performance.

3.title: 8.3 Procurement
3.description: The organization shall establish and implement criteria for evaluating energy performance when procuring energy-using products, equipment, and services that are expected to have a significant impact on energy performance.

1.title: 9.1 Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
1.description: The organization shall monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate its energy performance and the effectiveness of the EnMS at planned intervals. It must investigate and act on significant deviations.

template.description: Difference between targeted and actual consumption (CUSUM) charts.

2.title: 9.2 Internal Audit
2.description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the EnMS conforms to standard requirements and its own established criteria, and is effectively implemented and maintained.

3.title: 9.3 Management Review
3.description: Top management shall review the EnMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness. The review inputs must include energy performance data.
